source_row.rationale: Hepatitis A is primarily transmitted via the fecal-oral route, making hand hygiene a critical infection prevention measure, distinct from hepatitis B and C, which are primarily transmitted through blood and certain body fluid exposure.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Hepatitis A Transmission and Prevention
